- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 2, 3, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (1.69, contribution -0.73); 18/20 spot-checked, caption-inconsistent [F3] · Weak
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 7, 9, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (1.31, contribution -0.65); 20/20 AI spot-checked [F4] · Validated
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 4) · ↑ invasive · Low score (-0.06, contribution +0.58); failed AI spot check (0/20) · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful on test set (deletion drop +0.0114 vs random, 95% CI 0.0021–0.0197); all region risks here are 0.

## Could be wrong if
- Elevated nuclear shape variation (90th percentile, regions 4, 6, 8) reflects masked atypia or in situ carcinoma.
- Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (regions 2, 6, 8) obscures focal invasion (region 5) or mimics Normal tissue (77% similar).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 2, 4, 6, 8**: Confirm benign epithelium amid dense lymphocytic infiltrate and 90th-percentile nuclear shape variation.
2. **Regions 2, 3, 7, 9, 11**: Verify benign gland/tubule architecture and fibrous stroma or fat.
3. **Regions 1, 5, 6**: Exclude focal stromal infiltration (region 5), nuclear pleomorphism (region 6), or duct-confined atypia (region 1).
